content: No single canonical 'tool registry' pattern is documented by Next.js itself, but community App Router architecture guidance (feature-sliced design, enterprise patterns) converges on: colocate route logic under app/, keep a single source-of-truth data module (array/map of typed entries) outside app/ that drives derived UI (nav, cards, sitemap.ts, related-tools) via .map()/.filter(), never hand-duplicate entries across components.
